@MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv_C : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  d ≠ 0 → ∀ (a : R), (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d) (MvPolynomial.C a) = 0

theorem MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv_C.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  d ≠ 0 → ∀ (a : R), (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d) (MvPolynomial.C a) = 0 :=
fun {σ} {R} [CommSemiring R] {d} hd a ↦
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d) _a = 0) MvPolynomial.C_apply))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = 0) (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial d 0 a)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (MvPolynomial.monomial (0 - d)) (↑_a * a) = 0)
            ((MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff d 0).mpr (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg Not nonpos_iff_eq_zero._simp_1)) hd))))
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr (congrArg DFunLike.coe (congrArg MvPolynomial.monomial (zero_tsub d)))
                    (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul Nat.cast_zero) a) (zero_mul a)))
                  MvPolynomial.monomial_zero))
              0)
            (eq_self 0)))))
